product.v: Apple Mac mini (M6), as named by the aurora-wip T8152 DTS; the macOS 27.0 IPSW BuildManifest maps its Mac18,5 identity to board J873gAP and SoC 0x8152.

ipsw_identity.v: BuildManifest device/model identity Mac18,5; board configuration J873gAP / j873gap; SoC 0x8152. This is the IPSW-side join used with the DTS model field.

other_h18_id_generation.v: The compiler generation table associates T8150/A19 Pro with H18, CPU subtype 10, and ANE ISA 20; medium evidence, not a measured compile.

later_h18_ids_not_seen.reason: No T8160 or T8162 appeared in the complete macOS 27.0/13.5 BuildManifest and ADT extracts or the inspected iOS 27.0.1 iPhone18,1 inputs. This does not establish absence in unsearched iOS restore images or future releases.

ane_segment_ranges.reason: No segment-ranges property in the IPSW j873g ADT. A live macOS IORegistry/m1n1 ADT observation is required to discover iBoot's runtime firmware placement; not measured offline.

ane_domains.v: The ane clock-gates resolve to DCS2 and DCS3 and the ane1 clock-gates to AFIMCCNI1 and AFINS0 in the main pmgr device table, which has no power-state device with ANE in its name (AneAllSoc adt-27.0.txt summary). It does not show the T6021-style ANE_SYS/CPU/SET state sequence.

dart_sid.reason: No sid property in the IPSW ADT; a live IORegistry or trace is needed.

mailbox.reason: No separate mailbox node appears in the T8152 IPSW ADT. The host/ASC mailbox protocol and addresses are not identified by static ADT data; do not infer that the interface is integrated.

encryption_evidence.v: Each H18 IM4P has exactly four DER members (three IA5String fields plus one OCTET STRING payload), no fifth KBAG member; extracted payload begins with Mach-O 64-bit little-endian magic cffaedfe, not encryption or LZFSE. Do not decrypt; the image is freely readable.

macho.v: ARM64E MH_PRELOAD (filetype 5), flags 0x200001, entry PC 0, 7 load commands (sizeofcmds 0xb38): three LC_SEGMENT_64, LC_SYMTAB with 0 symbols, LC_DYSYMTAB, LC_UUID, LC_UNIXTHREAD. __TEXT vmaddr 0x0/vmsize 0xc4000/fileoff 0x4000/filesize 0xc4000; __DATA vmaddr 0xc4000/vmsize 0x2ac000/fileoff 0xc8000/filesize 0xb8000; __DATA_CONST vmaddr 0x370000/vmsize 0/fileoff 0x180000/filesize 0. Same layout in both H18 firmware payloads.

patchbay_vs_selene.v: __DATA._rtk_patchbay (0x282 bytes) parses as 45 {tag, u32 len, value} records, tags in memory byte order, the same list in both H18 payloads. The 27.0 H14 Selene payload (S7) has 40 records; H18 keeps all 40 tags and adds BECA, SECA, 1IEC, 2IEC and RIrW. Record values are not recorded.

power_control_names.v: CPowerControlServiceAneH18g / PowerControl_H18g. The H18 payloads contain InitPMUBaseAddress; the 27.0 Selene payload (S7) does not. A log string in the H18 payloads marks SetPMUBaseAddress deprecated.

buildmanifest_flags.v: For manifest key ANE (ane0): IsLoadedByiBoot=true and IsFUDFirmware=true. For Ap,ANE1 (ane1): IsLoadedByiBoot=false and IsFUDFirmware=true. For Ap,RestoreANE1: IsLoadedByiBoot=true; IsFUDFirmware absent. Three j873gap BuildIdentities repeat these entries.

csne_commands_vs_h14_selene.v: Unique CSNE_CMD_* identifier strings: H18 ane0 97; 27.0 H14/T602x Selene 97; H18-only names []; H14-only names [].

kernelcache_decompression.v: IM4P payload starts with LZFSE bvx2; decompressed to 125173760 bytes in memory; result is Mach-O 64-bit MH_FILESET. No decrypt step.

iop_ane_personality.v: AppleASCWrapV8ANE in com.apple.driver.AppleA7IOP-ASCWrap-v8.kext; IOKit personality IONameMatch=[iop-ane,ascwrap-v8], IOClass=AppleASCWrapV8ANE, IOProviderClass=AppleARMIODevice. This directly matches the T8152 ANE compatible and confirms Apple has a v8 ASCWrap driver.

ane_interface_kext.v: AppleH16ANEInterface.kext (bundle id com.apple.driver.AppleH16ANEInterface); its built-in t8020 and t8132exclave personalities bind IOClass H11ANEIn, not iop-ane,ascwrap-v8. It is not the matching H18 ASCWrap personality.

hal_name.v: AppleT8150ANEHAL string is present in AppleH16ANEInterface.kext executable. Kernelcache metadata does not identify AppleT8150ANEHAL as a separate kext bundle or IOKit personality; treat it as the observed H18 HAL identifier, not as a proven standalone kext name.

driver_family.v: Firmware-booted ASC with RTKit and CSNE: the ane_t6021 model, as a new ascwrap-v8 variant. The H18 payloads carry the RTKit release, the 97 CSNE_CMD names and every _rtk_patchbay record tag of the 27.0 H14 Selene payload (S7). Apple matches iop-ane,ascwrap-v8 with AppleASCWrapV8ANE in AppleA7IOP-ASCWrap-v8.kext (S6), not with the H11ANEIn interface. No Linux driver binds it; the per-SoC values a variant needs, and which of them are missing, are in receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h18.

aurora.v: aurora-wip contains t8152-j873g.dts, titled Apple Mac mini (M6), but no ANE node or H18 ANE driver. The file is a minimal RAM-boot DT. No ANE overlay target exists in linux-asahi 7.1.13.

hwx_generation.reason: The lab cross-target receipt contains h13-h17 and h11 only; it has no H18 result. The compiler research table associates H18 with A19/A19 Pro and T8150 (CPU subtype 10, ANE ISA 20), not with T8152/M6. That community association is not a T8152 oracle, so T8152/M6 subtype/ISA remain unknown.

hwx_community_h18_mapping.v: Compiler research table associates H18 with A19/A19 Pro, T8150, CPU subtype 10 and ANE ISA 20. The lab cross-target compile did not request h18. Do not transfer this mapping to T8152/M6.

hwx_lab_cross_target.v: 2026-09-05 M1 Ultra oracle compiled one fp16 add for h13 subtype 4, h14=5, h15=6, h16=7, h17=9; h11 failed. No h18 request/result.
